title: LLM-Augmented Flow for Project Conformation and Task Complexity Evaluation Based on the TLM Framework
title_zh: 基于 TLM 框架的 LLM 增强项目组建与任务复杂度评估流程

paragraphs.en: 基于 TLM 框架测试 LLM 辅助的发现阶段需求文档生成与任务复杂度评分流程，在真实金融科技项目中验证可行性。 The software development process, from inception to a working product or solution, can be divided into two major phases: discovery (Discovery) and delivery (Delivery). The Discovery is further subdivided into High-Level Discovery (HLD) and Low-Level Discovery (LLD). During HLD, management identifies the business solution or product to be integrated into the company's infrastructure. LLD, in turn, produces requirement documentation artifacts, including the Product Requirements Document (PRD), Business Requirements Document (BRD), and Functional Specifications Document (FSD). Story Points (SP) are a widely used modern approach to measuring the effort required to accomplish predetermined tasks, and the artifacts listed above help derive SP more precisely. With the rapid growth of LLM technologies, one of the main questions that arises is whether the whole Discovery phase, or most of it, can be completed with the help of LLM tools. In this paper, we test a framework that structures requirement documentation generation and task complexity scoring, based on the model introduced by (Tran, Lévesque, and Meunier 2004) and executed with the help of agentic tools. The approach is applied to a real-world commercial project in the fintech domain as a feasibility study rather than a validation: development effort was not recorded for the tasks examined, and the resulting complexity scores are therefore reported as the output of the instrument rather than as validated estimates of effort.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 TLM 框架测试 LLM 辅助的发现阶段需求文档生成与任务复杂度评分流程，在真实金融科技项目中验证可行性。软件开发过程从立项到产出可用的产品或解决方案，可以划分为两大阶段：发现（Discovery）和交付（Delivery）。 发现阶段进一步细分为高层发现（HLD）和低层发现（LLD）。 在高层发现阶段，管理层确定要集成到公司基础设施中的业务解决方案或产品。 低层发现阶段则产出需求文档制品，包括产品需求文档（PRD）、业务需求文档（BRD）和功能规格文档（FSD）。 故事点（SP）是一种被广泛使用的现代方法，用于衡量完成预定任务所需的工作量，而上述列出的文档制品有助于更精确地推导故事点。 随着 LLM 技术的快速发展，一个主要问题是：整个发现阶段，或者其中的大部分，能否借助 LLM 工具来完成。 在本文中，我们测试了一个用于结构化需求文档生成与任务复杂度评分的框架，该框架基于（Tran, Lévesque, and Meunier 2004）提出的模型，并借助智能体工具执行。 该方法应用于金融科技领域的一个真实商业项目，作为可行性研究而非验证性研究：所考察的任务未记录开发工作量，因此得出的复杂度评分仅作为该工具的输出结果报告，而非经过验证的工作量估算。
